loader.query:
select e from hunttech_LaborAgreement e join e.openPositions op
op = :openPosition

select e from hunttech_OpenPositionComment e order by e.dateComment desc
e.openPosition = :openPosition

select e from hunttech_SomeFilesOpenPosition e
e.openPosition = :openPosition

select e from hunttech_SkillTree e order by e.skillName
e.openPosition = :openPosition

select e from bpm$ProcAttachment e order by e.createTs
e.procInstance.entity.entityId = :entityId
select e from hunttech_OpenPosition e where (e.openClose is null or e.openClose=false) and not e.commandCandidate=0 order by e.vacansyName
select e from hunttech_Position e where e.positionRuName not like '%(не использовать)%' order by e.positionRuName

select e from hunttech_OpenPositionNews e order by e.dateNews desc
e.openPosition = :openPosition
e.priorityNews = :priorityNews

select e from hunttech_Project e where e.projectIsClosed is null or e.projectIsClosed=false order by e.projectName
e.projectDepartment = :department
e.projectIsClosed = :projectClosed
e in (select f.projectName from hunttech_OpenPosition f where not (f.openClose = :withOpenPosition) and f.projectName = e)
select e from hunttech_Company e order by e.comanyName

select e from hunttech_CompanyDepartament e where e.departamentRuName not like '%(не использовать)%' order by e.departamentRuName
e.companyName = :company
select e from hunttech_City e order by e.cityRuName
select e from hunttech_Grade e order by e.gradeName
